qa_pairs.question: Which engine types use the fuel pipe to pressure regulator connection?
What section of the manual covers fuel delivery and metering system torque specifications?
What is the difference in torque between the M8 and M12 fuel pipe coupling bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: The M8 bolt requires 9 Nm while the M12 bolt requires 20 Nm, a difference of 11 Nm

qa_pairs.question: Which fuel system components are covered under subsection 13.31?
qa_pairs.answer: Fuel Pump with Drive and Pipes

qa_pairs.question: What engine management system types are specified for the fuel pipe coupling bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: K-Jetr for both M8 and M12 bolts, and L-Jetr for pressure regulator connections
